name: efs
description: Amazon Elastic File System Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) provides simple, scalable file storage for use with Amazon EC2 Linux and Mac instances in the Amazon Web Services Cloud.

subcommands.name: create-access-point
subcommands.description: Creates an EFS access point.

subcommands.name: create-file-system
subcommands.description: Creates a new, empty file system.

subcommands.name: create-mount-target
subcommands.description: Creates a mount target for a file system.

subcommands.name: create-replication-configuration
subcommands.description: Creates a replication conﬁguration to either a new or existing EFS file system.

subcommands.name: create-tags
subcommands.description: DEPRECATED - CreateTags is deprecated and not maintained.

subcommands.name: delete-access-point
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified access point.

subcommands.name: delete-file-system
subcommands.description: Deletes a file system, permanently severing access to its contents.

subcommands.name: delete-file-system-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes the FileSystemPolicy for the specified file system.

subcommands.name: delete-mount-target
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified mount target.

subcommands.name: delete-replication-configuration
subcommands.description: Deletes a replication configuration.

subcommands.name: delete-tags
subcommands.description: DEPRECATED - DeleteTags is deprecated and not maintained.

subcommands.name: describe-access-points
subcommands.description: Returns the description of a specific Amazon EFS access point if the AccessPointId is provided.

subcommands.name: describe-account-preferences
subcommands.description: Returns the account preferences settings for the Amazon Web Services account associated with the user making the request, in the current Amazon Web Services Region.

subcommands.name: describe-backup-policy
subcommands.description: Returns the backup policy for the specified EFS file system.

subcommands.name: describe-file-system-policy
subcommands.description: Returns the FileSystemPolicy for the specified EFS file system.

subcommands.name: describe-file-systems
subcommands.description: Returns the description of a specific Amazon EFS file system if either the file system CreationToken or the FileSystemId is provided.

subcommands.name: describe-lifecycle-configuration
subcommands.description: Returns the current LifecycleConfiguration object for the specified EFS file system.

subcommands.name: describe-mount-target-security-groups
subcommands.description: Returns the security groups currently in effect for a mount target.

subcommands.name: describe-mount-targets
subcommands.description: Returns the descriptions of all the current mount targets, or a specific mount target, for a file system.

subcommands.name: describe-replication-configurations
subcommands.description: Retrieves the replication configuration for a specific file system.

subcommands.name: describe-tags
subcommands.description: DEPRECATED - The DescribeTags action is deprecated and not maintained.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists all tags for a top-level EFS resource.

subcommands.name: modify-mount-target-security-groups
subcommands.description: Modifies the set of security groups in effect for a mount target.

subcommands.name: put-account-preferences
subcommands.description: Use this operation to set the account preference in the current Amazon Web Services Region to use long 17 character (63 bit) or short 8 character (32 bit) resource IDs for new EFS file system and mount target resources.

subcommands.name: put-backup-policy
subcommands.description: Updates the file system's backup policy.

subcommands.name: put-file-system-policy
subcommands.description: Applies an Amazon EFS FileSystemPolicy to an Amazon EFS file system.

subcommands.name: put-lifecycle-configuration
subcommands.description: Use this action to manage storage for your file system.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Creates a tag for an EFS resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes tags from an EFS resource.

subcommands.name: update-file-system
subcommands.description: Updates the throughput mode or the amount of provisioned throughput of an existing file system.

subcommands.name: update-file-system-protection
subcommands.description: Updates protection on the file system.
